description: GDACS alert level: Red. From 14/10/2026 to 23/10/2026, a Hurricane/Typhoon > 74 mph (maximum wind speed of 296 km/h) CHAMPI-26 was active in NWPacific. The cyclone affects these countries: Philippines, Guam, Northern Mariana Islands, Japan (vulnerability Medium). Estimated population affected by category 1 (120 km/h) wind speeds or higher is 0.181 million .

places.title: Japan
places.extract: Japan is an island country in East Asia. Located in the Pacific Ocean off the northeast coast of the Asian mainland, it is bordered to the west by the Sea of Japan, the Sea of Okhotsk in the north, and the East China Sea in the south. The Japanese archipelago consists of four major islands alongside over 14,000 smaller islands. Japan is divided into 47 administrative prefectures and eight traditional regions, and around 75% of its terrain is mountainous and heavily forested, concentrating its agriculture and highly urbanized population along its eastern coastal plains. With a population of almost 123 million as of 2026, it is the world's 11th most populous country. Tokyo is the country's capital and largest city.

places.title: Philippines
places.extract: The Philippines, officially the Republic of the Philippines, is an archipelagic country in Southeast Asia. Located in the western Pacific Ocean, it consists of about 7,641 islands, with a total area of about 300,000 square kilometers. The islands are broadly categorized into three main geographical divisions: from north to south, Luzon, Visayas, and Mindanao. With a population of over 114 million, it is the world's thirteenth-most-populous country.
